svg.title: Hi, I'm Wenyao — an embodied AI researcher.
svg.desc: Beijing, China. Research focus: VLA, WAM, Reinforcement Learning, Action Chunking, and Real-Robot Learning. Research in practice: SFT/RL post-training and data loops; real-time control, deployment, and evaluation; Embodied RSI/Harness with memory, recovery, and feedback-driven adaptation.
